Bug Report
Describe the Bug
A clear and concise description of what the bug is.
To Reproduce
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
	1	Go to ‘…’

	3	Scroll down to ‘….’
	4	See error
If applicable, provide a minimal reproducible code example or the command you ran (e.g., python simulations/thrust_model.py --b_opposing 50 --frequency 100).

A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.
Actual Behavior
What actually happened, including any error messages or unexpected outputs.
Screenshots/Logs
If applicable, add screenshots, error logs, or console output to help explain the problem. For code errors, paste the traceback here (use code blocks for formatting).
Environment

	•	OS: [e.g., Windows 11, macOS Ventura, Ubuntu 24.04]
	•	Python Version: [e.g., 3.12.3]
	•	Relevant Dependencies: [e.g., list versions of numpy, torch, sympy if used; run pip list or pip freeze]
	•	Repository Version/Commit: [e.g., main branch, commit hash if applicable]
Additional Context
Add any other context about the problem here, such as related issues or workarounds you’ve tried.
Priority
(Optional) Suggest a priority level (P0 - critical, P4 - low) based on impact. Reference: Google Issue Tracker Priority Levels
